tools.description: List every deadline rule set 1Court covers, with rule counts and scope. Coverage: Deadlines: California in depth (civil, family, probate, eviction, small claims, government claims, criminal, juvenile, appeals, agencies, pre-suit clocks, special proceedings, statutes of limitations; local rules for all 58 counties), federal civil and criminal, federal bankruptcy, and a partial Texas set. Returns up to 20 rules with their rule_set, rule_id and rule page URL; use get_rule or calculate_deadline next.

tools.description: Every deadline that follows one trigger event, like a docketing system: court, trigger, date in; all resulting deadlines out, each with its date, the rule citation, the official source and the 1Court rule page. Deadlines that apply only to some case types (limited civil, asbestos, PI Pathway...) are listed separately. For broad triggers (a motion hearing covers every motion type), pass kind to narrow (e.g. "Noticed motion", "Motion for summary judgment"); otherwise the usual kind is chosen and the rest are listed as other_deadlines. Ask the user for the trigger date and how the paper was served; do not assume them. Show the user the citation and source link with every date or rule. Results are not legal advice. Coverage: Deadlines: California in depth (civil, family, probate, eviction, small claims, government claims, criminal, juvenile, appeals, agencies, pre-suit clocks, special proceedings, statutes of limitations; local rules for all 58 counties), federal civil and criminal, federal bankruptcy, and a partial Texas set.
